title: AID Protocol v2 — VerificationReport
description: Artifact emitted by aid-evidence-verify.sh. Carries the protocol-v2 envelope and a deterministic evidence-pack verification result. verdict.kind is always 'none' — this tool reports, it does not release.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

verification_report.$comment: enforced — required root payload key; inner shape is reference only

evidence_pack.description: Identification of the evidence pack that was verified.

git.description: Git workspace state at verification time.

pack_head.description: Shared head_sha across all v2 artifacts in the pack. Null if pack has no v2 artifacts.

checks.description: Per-check results. Each entry corresponds to one deterministic invariant.

target.description: Artifact path or file this check applies to (null for pack-level checks).

evidence.description: Machine evidence: exit code, git output, file:line, etc.

summary.description: Aggregated verdict across all required checks.

verified.description: True only when no required check is fail or unverifiable.

blocking_reasons.description: List of required checks that caused verified=false.
